item.title: Board 1.8.0
item.description:
The store opens, and a round of fixes from a review of the whole app.

Added

  • Buy Board. $27.99 once, through Lemon Squeezy. On a Mac in Jordan (by its region, time zone or a "-JO" language, as on the website) the price shows as JOD 19.85, with a note everywhere it's shown, the Board menu included, that checkout bills $27.99 in US dollars. It follows a change of region or time zone without a relaunch.
  • Click outside a task to close it. A click on the board outside any card, or on the header, closes the details panel and keeps the selection, as Esc does. A click on another card opens that one instead.

Changed

  • Check Now says what it found (Settings ▸ License): "Checking…" while it asks, then that the license is active, why it isn't, or that Lemon Squeezy couldn't be reached.
  • A license stays with the Mac it was activated on, and entering the same key again checks this Mac's activation rather than spending another one; a different key frees the old activation.
  • AI assistants: today shows meetings only when you've shared your connections, like the other connection tools. delete_task says when a deletion can't be undone (Board's window closed) instead of promising undo.
  • A save that fails is said once, in an alert, rather than lost quietly; the rest are logged.
  • Google Calendar reads every page of the coming week, and asks Google to leave out working-location events.
  • Connect right after Test uses what Test found, so a work service isn't asked for everything twice.
  • Jev's note says what is sent: the task's text, its due date and your group names.

Fixed

  • Prayer times on the days the clocks change were an hour off after the change, and the evening before could skip the next day. A summer Isha after midnight (far north) is no longer skipped, and the chime stops when Show next prayer is off.
  • Notes an assistant writes while the task is open show at once, rather than being overwritten by your next keystroke.
  • Focus sessions: +10 min or Back to it during the meeting that ended a session keeps going; a meeting inside a long event (say "WFH 9–5") gets its warning and ends the session; the Mac sleeping pauses the session, and changing the clock is neither counted nor taken off.
  • A malformed date from an AI assistant no longer quits Board. Times with a zone but no seconds are read, and days that don't exist (31 September) are refused.
  • Times on the days the clocks change: reminders "on the day", End of Week, Add time, the weekly review and wind-down are no longer an hour off.
  • Moving to another time zone moves Today, Overdue and the week with you.
  • A task deleted while the carry-over prompt or the weekly review is open is left out rather than moved.
  • A Keychain that can't be read no longer turns a licensed copy read-only.
  • The ambient sound stops properly when the audio device changes as it fades out, the focus sound plays while ambient mode is silent, and the sound follows Reduce Motion.
  • Smaller things: ⌥⌘K opens the details panel to add a comment; the custom monthly repeat saves the day it shows; a thrown-away blank task can't come back with ⌘Z; ⌫ on a read-only board leaves the selection where it was; the selection no longer lands on a folded Done column; cursors no longer stick after a panel closes; Sort Inbox leaves tasks changed while it was open; the widgets see a focus session end when Board quits, and reload less often; buttons that are only an icon have names for VoiceOver.
